column1: # Argument frames of the grid predicates. One row per slot, in Japanese word order; a frame is filled twice
# (fill 1, fill 2) with nouns of the slot's class. role: subj (dropped in requests, prohibitions and invitations),
# obj, dat (person + に), goal (に/へ), loc (place of action で, place of existence or contact に), path (を),
# com (と), src (から), cmp (より). ja1/ja2: the Japanese particle of fill 1 / fill 2.
